verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כִּ֣י אִשָּׁה֙ תַזְרִ֔יעַ וְיָלְדָ֖ה זָכָ֑ר וְטָֽמְאָה֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים כִּימֵ֛י נִדַּ֥ת דְּוֺתָ֖הּ תִּטְמָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr kî ’iš·šāh ṯaz·rî·a‘ wə·yā·lə·ḏāh zā·ḵār wə·ṭā·mə·’āh šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm kî·mê nid·daṯ də·wō·ṯāh tiṭ·mā
verses.literal: Say to the Israelites . . . - - A woman who becomes pregnant and gives birth to a son will be unclean for seven days as she is during the days of her menstruation . . . . . .
And on the eighth day the flesh of [the boy’s] foreskin is to be circumcised

verses.original: תֵּשֵׁ֖ב טָהֳרָ֑ה בִּדְמֵ֣י וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יוֹם֙ יָמִ֔ים לֹֽא־ תִגָּ֗ע בְּכָל־ קֹ֣דֶשׁ תָבֹ֔א וְאֶל־ הַמִּקְדָּשׁ֙ לֹ֣א עַד־ יְמֵ֥י טָהֳרָֽהּ׃ מְלֹ֖את
verses.transliteration: tê·šêḇ ṭā·ho·rāh biḏ·mê ū·šə·lō·šîm ū·šə·lō·šeṯ yō·wm yā·mîm lō- ṯig·gā‘ bə·ḵāl qō·ḏeš ṯā·ḇō wə·’el- ham·miq·dāš lō ‘aḏ- yə·mê ṭā·ho·rāh mə·lōṯ
verses.literal: The woman shall continue in purification from her bleeding for thirty-three . . . days She must not touch anything sacred or go into the sanctuary . . . until the days of her purification are complete

verses.original: וְאִם־ תֵלֵ֔ד נְקֵבָ֣ה וְטָמְאָ֥ה שְׁבֻעַ֖יִם כְּנִדָּתָ֑הּ תֵּשֵׁ֖ב עַל־ טָהֳרָֽה׃ דְּמֵ֥י וְשִׁשִּׁ֥ים יוֹם֙ וְשֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ṯê·lêḏ nə·qê·ḇāh wə·ṭā·mə·’āh šə·ḇu·‘a·yim kə·nid·dā·ṯāh tê·šêḇ ‘al- ṭā·ho·rāh də·mê wə·šiš·šîm yō·wm wə·šê·šeṯ yā·mîm
verses.literal: If, however she gives birth to a daughter [the woman] will be unclean for two weeks as she is during her menstruation Then she must continue in purification from her bleeding for sixty-six . . . . . . days

verses.original: יְמֵ֣י טָהֳרָ֗הּ וּבִמְלֹ֣את׀ לְבֵן֮ א֣וֹ לְבַת֒ תָּבִ֞יא אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃ אֶל־ פֶּ֥תַח אֹֽהֶל־ מוֹעֵ֖ד בֶּן־ שְׁנָתוֹ֙ כֶּ֤בֶשׂ לְעֹלָ֔ה וּבֶן־ יוֹנָ֥ה אוֹ־ תֹ֖ר לְחַטָּ֑את
verses.transliteration: yə·mê ṭā·ho·rāh ū·ḇim·lōṯ lə·ḇên ’ōw lə·ḇaṯ tā·ḇî ’el- hak·kō·hên ’el- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel- mō·w·‘êḏ ben- šə·nā·ṯōw ke·ḇeś lə·‘ō·lāh ū·ḇen- yō·w·nāh ’ōw- ṯōr lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ
verses.literal: When the days of her purification are complete whether for a son or for a daughter she is to bring to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting a year-old . . . lamb for a burnt offering and a young pigeon or a turtledove for a sin offering

verses.original: וְהִקְרִיב֞וֹ לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ וְכִפֶּ֣ר עָלֶ֔יהָ וְטָהֲרָ֖ה מִמְּקֹ֣ר דָּמֶ֑יהָ זֹ֤את תּוֹרַת֙ הַיֹּלֶ֔דֶת לַזָּכָ֖ר א֥וֹ לַנְּקֵבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·rî·ḇōw lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·ḵip·per ‘ā·le·hā wə·ṭā·hă·rāh mim·mə·qōr dā·me·hā zōṯ tō·w·raṯ hay·yō·le·ḏeṯ laz·zā·ḵār ’ōw lan·nə·qê·ḇāh
verses.literal: And [the priest] will present them before the LORD and make atonement for her and she shall be ceremonially cleansed from her flow of blood This is the law for a woman giving birth whether to a male or to a female

verses.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֨א תִמְצָ֣א דֵּ֣י יָדָהּ֮ שֶׂה֒ וְלָקְחָ֣ה שְׁתֵּֽי־ תֹרִ֗ים א֤וֹ שְׁנֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֔ה אֶחָ֥ד לְעֹלָ֖ה וְאֶחָ֣ד לְחַטָּ֑את הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְכִפֶּ֥ר עָלֶ֛יהָ וְטָהֵֽרָה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- lō ṯim·ṣā dê yā·ḏāh śeh wə·lā·qə·ḥāh šə·tê- ṯō·rîm ’ōw šə·nê bə·nê yō·w·nāh ’e·ḥāḏ lə·‘ō·lāh wə·’e·ḥāḏ lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ hak·kō·hên wə·ḵip·per ‘ā·le·hā wə·ṭā·hê·rāh
verses.literal: But if she cannot afford . . . . . . a lamb she shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons one for a burnt offering and the other for a sin offering Then the priest will make atonement for her and she will be clean
